system.description:
Lore: Relic Wand

Vellynne Harpell keeps one on her belt and reaches for it more readily than she admits. It has the following Powers:

  • Magic Missile: Holds 3 charges, all of which return after a Rest. Expend a charge to send three darts of force at Beings you can see within Far, dealing 1d4+1 damage each. The darts never miss. Spend up to 3 further charges to send one extra dart each.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
